Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: A Game of Dice
Cards.Text: Limited: Draw two additional cards during your next End Phase.

Cards.Name: A Yojimbo's Duty
Cards.Text:
Open: Destroy your performing Yojimbo and target your discarded Courtier or Shugenja: Bring him into play, paying all costs but reducing his Gold cost to enter play by your Yojimbo's base Gold Cost plus 1.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him. You may take an additional action appropriate to this phase.

Cards.Name: Accidental Confession
Cards.Text: Open: Choose your performing unbowed Courtier, discard the Imperial Favor, and target a Personality: Dishonor him. His controller may not assign him, and he will not move, to battlefields this turn.

Cards.Name: Broken Alliance
Cards.Text:
Battle/Open: Target an attachment and pay Gold equal to its Gold Cost minus two: Destroy it.
Battle: If there are enemy units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality: Move him there. Straighten him if he moved.

Cards.Name: Cast Aside the Weak
Cards.Text:
Open: Choose your performing Samurai: Straighten his unit.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Samurai and target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it. Destroy it if your Samurai is a Paragon.

Cards.Name: Consideration
Cards.Text: Open: Choose your performing unbowed Tactician and target another of your Personalities: Give the Personality +3F. After the next time this turn another player's action targets him, negate its effects.

Cards.Name: Creating Order
Cards.Text: Battle/Open: Target one or two Personalities: Either negate all current and new Force bonuses and penalties on them from actions, or straighten their units.

Cards.Name: Duel of Haiku
Cards.Text: Open: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and target another player's Personality: Your Personality duels the other. In this duel, each Personality uses Personal Honor as his duel stat. The duel's winner's controller gains 1 Honor. Bow and dishonor the duel's loser.

Cards.Name: Entrenched Position
Cards.Text:
Reaction: After the Attacker announces a Battle action before the Defender's first normal opportunity to act or pass: Negate its effects.
Battle: Target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it.

Cards.Name: Feint & Strike
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: After this duel's resolution, its winner's controller discards a card.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Commander and target an enemy Personality: If your Commander has a Follower, you may target and destroy an attachment in the Personality's unit. Move him home.
